name: Local SEO Lesson - Module 7 Key Local SEO Ranking Factors
body:
> Lesson · 2026-10-08

# Summary
A mental checklist of the main local ranking factors and how to self-audit against each.

# Factors
1. GBP primary category and completeness (a wrong category can block visibility).
2. NAP consistency and citations.
3. Backlinks and domain authority (local links from chambers or newspapers carry local relevance).
4. Reviews: quantity, velocity, diversity, rating.
5. Proximity to the searcher or city centroid (mostly outside your control).
6. On-page signals: city and service in titles and headings, localized content.
7. Behavioral signals: clicks, calls, direction requests, on-site engagement.

# Suggested priority of controllable work
GBP optimization, then citation consistency, reviews, backlinks/content, on-page.

# How this applies to TAG clients
- Useful framing for client reports: explain which factors TAG controls and which (like proximity) set realistic expectations.
- Reports for Scott and clients are built in [Client Report Dashboard](lib:brain-client-report-dashboard).
